patches.summary: The node cannot decide a die face: RollEngine checks the node hash against a local SHA3-256 (Sha3.java) and refuses a malformed or repeated node random; a refused answer discards the throw, stops auto-roll and re-verifies the node; the last-word pick refuses the same way; MainActivity.verifyNode uses the same check.
The node is asked for random only; SHA3(a ++ b) is worked out on the phone and b is never sent; any node failure during a throw is said and the node re-verified; the audit keeps the local hash.
SHA3-256 self-test at startup; comments.

A .shop pays the token its currency names (MerchMessage.tokenFor/tokenProblem): refused on import, open, before the Pay question, before the order is sent and on Retry payment (here also in PaymentJournal.paymentOrder/saveOrder); the question shows the amount, token id and vendor address whole; shared comms MerchDb flags TOKEN_MISMATCH and decides PAID by the token received.
Shared comms parity: MerchDb.coinAmount and the positive-total gate.
Identifiers in full: shortId() and Util.shorten() removed; token ids and addresses shown whole.
MxUSD in every displayed currency (MerchMessage.label); wire value USDT unchanged.
Plain-price rule (Catalog.plain/priceProblem/problem): non-plain prices or fees, stock below one and a zero total are refused on import, open and before the question.

Shared comms parity (MerchDb from Inbox 0.5.15-0.5.18); already in this snapshot's MerchDb with 2.2.62-2.2.66. Shop 0.4.18 (standalone Retry payment) is not ported: this snapshot's PaymentJournal already decides retries.

Shared comms parity (MerchDb from Inbox 0.5.21). Shop 0.4.20 (standalone retry state written before the send) is not ported: this snapshot's PaymentJournal decides retries; 2.2.67 adds the whole question.
H1: the order carries a secret, the payment its commitment in port 2 (here via PaymentFlow, and OrderPaymentEvidence.referenceStamp accepts that port 2); 64-bit refs.
INFO: the MXUSD constant.
Shared MerchDb identical to Inbox 0.5.28 (delta H-1/M-1/M-2). Integrated also: L-d exact commitment in the payment stamp, an order with a secret never paid with port 1 only.
Shared MerchDb identical to Inbox 0.5.30.
Shared MerchDb identical to Inbox 0.5.39.
Shared comms parity: MerchMessage token rule and MerchDb TOKEN_MISMATCH flag and payment gate.
Shared comms parity: MerchDb.coinAmount and the positive-total gate.
Identifiers in full: Util.shorten() removed; the listing token id shown whole.
Shared comms parity: MerchMessage.label. (Here also: the snapshot's own currency label and button said mxUSDT; now MxUSD, as the source already did.)
The .shop export writes prices and fees as plain decimals (Util.plainAmount).
Shared comms parity (MerchDb from Inbox 0.5.15-0.5.18); already in this snapshot's MerchDb with 2.2.62-2.2.66.
Shared comms parity (MerchDb from Inbox 0.5.21). Here also (Pandamonium only): every export saves the published shop to files/mall_listings for the Inbox.
Shared comms parity (C1/H1).
M1: the export carries the listing signed with the shop key.
Shared MerchDb identical to Inbox 0.5.28.
Delta L-c: the signed listing carries kind minimall-listing-v1 and signedAt.
Shared MerchDb identical to Inbox 0.5.30.
Shared MerchDb identical to Inbox 0.5.39 (0.3.25); listing sealed on io from the snapshot and plainAmount bounded (0.3.26); comments (0.3.27).

An order is paid in the token its currency names: shared comms MerchDb stores the currency token, flags a disagreeing stated token id TOKEN_MISMATCH (never auto-delivered), decides PAID by the token received and sets paid only on PAID; the order screen names what was received by its whole token id.
A payment coin is measured by its own token amount (MerchDb.coinAmount: tokenamount for a token coin); an order total not above zero is never paid.
Identifiers in full: shortId() and Util.shorten() removed; keys, coin ids, txpow ids, token ids and addresses shown whole.
MxUSD in every displayed currency and the CSV export (dispCurrency uses MerchMessage.label); wire value USDT unchanged.
Mitigation: DeliveryGuard before every send (never Minima/MxUSD, 0 decimals confirmed by the node, never more than held); automatic delivery off and not switchable; whole Send NFT question.
Payment coins of the currency's token add up, each coin id counted once; only PAID locks; a stranger's coin never blocks.
Mismatch flag stored apart from the status (MerchDb.mismatch); nothing is sent for a flagged order whatever its status.
One-time repair of rows marked paid for a wrong or short coin; MerchDb.deliverable re-checked from a fresh row before every send.

Orders checked against the vendor's own imported .shop (Listing): due recomputed from listed prices, stock and fees; recordPayment compares with it; any listing problem stops delivery; unchecked orders say their total is the buyer's own figure.

The vendor cannot be drained: DeliveryRules (listing required, only listed lines, stock across orders, paid in full on chain with confirmations, once only, buyer address) and DeliveryLedger; automatic delivery a vendor setting (default off). Here also: the listing comes from Studio's export in this app's files, the ledger guards the delivery journals, and refusals are localized.
Review M1: bounded buyer numbers, length-capped buyer strings, fail-closed recheck catching Throwable.
Review M2/L3/L4 (MerchDb): deliverable requires a checked order, PAID follows a recomputed due, old TOKEN_MISMATCH rows become durable flags.
C1: refs must be valid; a payment coin must carry the ref in port 1 as valid hex UTF-8; sends need MerchDb.deliverable.
H1: conflict flag for a second different order with one ref; order secret + payment commitment in port 2; oldest-first scanning.
M2/M3: items over 64 KB or 8 deep refused unread; payment coins read by the currency's token, bounded.
M1: only a listing signed by this shop key (listingSealed); summary before use (standalone); NFT at 0 refused. Here: Studio's save lives in getDir(mall_listings), signed too.
L1/L2/L5/INFO: collection and pieces share stock; editions are StateNFT one-unit coins; identical lines get distinct keys; MXUSD constant.

Unsigned .shop (desktop builder, older Studio) usable only through the vendor's explicit import: full summary under a not-signed warning, Use this listing each time; vendor key and NFT price rules unchanged; order screen shows signed or vendor-confirmed. Integrated adds localized strings and lets a confirmed import stand until Studio publishes again.

Delta H-1/M-1/M-2/L-f: a different second order with a stored ref is kept beside it (secret) or ignored (no secret vs secret), its coins flag and count nothing, the vendor may switch to the committed order only; commitment coins pay only their order, reference-only orders only coins without port 2; chat only from the order's buyer with sender; strict hex UTF-8 refs; conflict screen reworded.

Delta L-a/L-b/L-c: payment coin read bounded by the order's block or date; summary entries one line, control/bidi characters removed, capped; diff against the signed inner shopId; signed text must be kind minimall-listing-v1; older-listing warning. Integrated adds translated summary words.

Final check M-A/L-A/L-B/L-C: contended coins flag only at the contender's listed due; a secret order paid in full is deliverable; commitments past 8 kept orders recorded (cap 64, then overflow mark); full coin list offers no switch; no-secret newcomer kept, unassigned coins shown; switch checks in its transaction and moves counted coins. Integrated adds L-D (stale POSTING to UNKNOWN after 10 blocks, re-send pinned to the released inputs).

Point release 2026-11-21 (0.5.31-0.5.39): payment coins kept with their block and read back by id, never the address; stock per listing; no notification storm; NFT-only digital orders fee 0; re-send reuses the first attempt's coins and 'it WAS sent'; older-Shop order that came first deliverable to the order of record; upgrade handling; order screen and scanners on io; lifecycle guards; nits.

Point release fixes (0.5.40-0.5.45): bookmarks through the io queue, drained on close (M1); legacy payments: Find this order's payment, confirmed coins keep their data, record-time confirmation, GONE back-off (M2); contender blocks in the order-of-record evidence (m2); unsigned listing id by content and one-time ledger tagging (m3); io and wording nits (m4). Standalone only: real send coins kept (m1).

Payment matching (0.5.46-0.5.49, Pandamonium 2.2.83-2.2.86): no automatic delivery for an order with no secret (P1); a payment is judged only once the tip and the orders read reach its block + 3, orders read before payments, a failed read keeps the bookmark, the payment scan re-reads its gap + 8 blocks (P2); a no-secret order is not paid by a coin more than 3 blocks older than the order, its block stored with it (P3); the order-of-record wording states only what is known (P4).

Payment matching rework (0.5.50-0.5.54, Pandamonium 2.2.87-2.2.91): a payment coin is judged the first time it is seen again (R1); a coin older than a no-secret order is counted with the olderpay note, confirm with the buyer (R2); counted coins are shown as the node gave them (R5); the Send confirmation and order screen of a no-secret order show the old-Shop facts (R3); a partly read scan reads the rest in coinage: windows and never claims unread blocks, a gap over the window is shown (R4).

Scanner and order-screen polish (0.5.55-0.5.61, Pandamonium 2.2.93-2.2.100, reviewer r3): a pass reads the tip again and the blocks it moved by, the orders scan re-reads the 8-block margin (I1); the payment scan keeps its own read-whole mark (I2); unread lines say window or refused, one line per range, rows deleted on dismiss (I3); a stalled orders scan shows one red line (I4); no-secret orders without NFT lines show the older-Shop facts and confirm/ship asks first (I5); sendNft refuses an automatic no-secret send itself (I6); an identical re-sent order keeps its earliest block (I7).

Final review (0.5.62-0.5.66, Pandamonium 2.2.104-2.2.108): the orders scan reads its gap only, a failed tip read is read again, a moved tip's blocks are read with the margin, a pass that read every page is not counted as refused, the stalled line names the first block not read and needs refused blocks, refused only where refused passes tried (F1); a kept order read again does not flag a resolved conflict (F2); the stalled line alone refreshes only the orders list (F3); DELIVERED of a no-secret order asks first unless SHIPPED (F4); a no-secret order's coin is shown once (F6).

Final review, phone (0.5.67, Pandamonium 2.2.109): a scan pass that read every page but could not confirm the tip (held) keeps the refused blocks and the count of refused passes; only a whole pass clears them.
